heading.title: Of the Duites and Powers of Registering Officers

article.title: Endorsements to be dated and signed by registering officer.
article.content:
59Endorsements to be dated and signed by registering officer.

Section 59  ·  Part XI  ·  (B) As to the procedure on admitting to registration  ·  page 35 of the Act
The registering officer shall affix the date and his signature to all endorsements made under sections 52 and 58, relating to the same document and made in his presence on the same day.
